items.text: Honor and obey your parents and fulfill all filial duties.
items.quote: Are the young and strong (here) observant of their filial and fraternal duties?

items.text: Respect and defer to your elder siblings as your fraternal duty.
items.quote: Are the young and strong (here) observant of their filial and fraternal duties?

items.text: When a son is born, place a bow and six arrows at the left of the door to set before him the spheres of his life's work.
items.quote: when a son is born, a bow of mulberry wood, and six arrows of the wild raspberry plant
